changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Request the normal energy worker once for classified imported tracks with canonical points. Changeset 082 already handles the full GPS rebuild for upgrades from the last release. This request also covers development databases where 082 has already completed. New imports and replacements continue to enqueue energy through normal classification.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO public.track_energy_recalculation (track_id, generation, requested_at, next_attempt_at) SELECT t.id, 1, now(), now() FROM public.gps_track t WHERE COALESCE(t.track_source, 'IMPORTED') = 'IMPORTED' AND t.activity_type IS NOT NULL AND NOT COALESCE(t.timing_unreliable, false) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM gps_track_data d JOIN gps_track_data_points p ON p.gps_track_data_id = d.id WHERE d.gps_track_id = t.id AND d.track_type = 'RAW_OUTLIER_CLEANED') ON CONFLICT (track_id) DO UPDATE SET generation = track_energy_recalculation.generation + 1, requested_at = now(), next_attempt_at = now(), last_error = NULL;
